# authwise_guard_relay (Data Source)

A relay a Guard network's nodes connect through when no direct path exists. guard-control serves a network's relays to its nodes, lowest `priority` first. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `ca_cert_pem` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_relay_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `network_id` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `region` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `url` (String)
